name: JK Soukan
source:
Which of the twins is your target for revenge? 

If you don't know, take revenge on both of them for collective responsibility!

There's no doubt that one of the twins framed you...

However, since the twins adamantly refuse to answer which one it is, you decide to take revenge on both of them!

[Edited from DMM]
